scope: These are research simulations on already exposed events, NOT the original demo and NOT fresh generalization. All original negative decisions retained.

attribution: Plant path matters: R10 core detects +40 ms on genuine R10-plant inputs, but the same core misses on D-plant inputs and has a separate 3.903 s normal-release false rise.

Observer path matters independently: on the same R10 sensor record Coupled is already alarmed at 3.906 s and masks the later pulse; on the same D record Coupled suppresses the 3.903 s nuisance but also misses the sentinel.

The available collision evidence is corrected positive-fz innovation: D/Coupled peaks at score 3.723842 at 3.984 s; raw fz 9.06749 N becomes corrected 10.47370 N, so the normal correction does not attenuate the peak. The frozen 8-consecutive rule never fires, showing temporal fragmentation rather than peak removal.

The repair fails by calibration competition: sentinel leaky evidence peaks at 5.14466, while the all-normal threshold is 31.19497 because the eight largest normal maxima all occur in cases with genuine pick/tool contact. This is an allowed-signal ambiguity, not proof that the external sentinel is absent.
limitations: new simulations, not original demo replay
no physical separation guarantee for positive-normal external vs legitimate tool contact from scalar channel alone

observed_open_edge_b.non_observability: The scalar leaky corrected-positive-fz statistic is not separable on the frozen normals: benign pc_heavy_up reaches 6.025945 at +18 ms after the observed grip edge, above the forced sentinel maximum 5.144658 at +89 ms. No threshold choice is justified without dropping an adversarial normal or adding a forbidden clock/case mask.

failure_attribution: The predictor separates the old 16 N sentinel from its same-arm normal twin and raises at +21 ms versus R10 +40 ms.

After a genuine force, the plant remains displaced from the normal-only age-conditioned trajectory. With clear-after-8, the auxiliary decision repeatedly rearms, producing 54 postlanding false rises in the sentinel and additional false rises in two other exposed forced cases.
This is a recovery-state/model contract failure, not permission to lower or refit the frozen normal envelope using external outcomes.

Pre-edge forced cases intentionally abstain when the pulse contaminates bounded pre-edge features; a heavy feature-outside-support case also abstains. The unchanged Coupled OR remains active and preserves its positives.
limitations: seven previously exposed external cases only

rule.prediction: unchanged frozen R17C model and support policy
rule.decision: OR across simultaneous qualifying channels, then OR unchanged Coupled; clear after 8 below and may rearm without blind/refractory/latch
rule.physical_floor_provenance: unchanged R10/R14 fast force/moment and positive-fz thresholds

physical_corroboration_d.failure_cause: Every remaining late false rise is same-direction positive fz whose actual corrected physical innovation exceeds the unchanged 2.812605901696073 N floor: 2.94384, 3.63113, 3.19454, and 3.64887 N. Their normal-prediction mismatch ratios are also 1.3215--1.4042. These are real post-event impulses, not vanishing-envelope-only artifacts. Raising the floor from exposed outcomes is forbidden.
strengths: sentinel genuine detection +29 ms versus R10 +40 ms
34 normals no added/lost rise and zero coincidence samples
physical_corroboration_d.stop: No more detector candidates without new evidence; no new external cases opened.
physical_corroboration_d.contact_conclusion: All four remaining late rises occur after the 5.3 s final return waypoint with grip=false, f_ext=0 N, and f_tool=0 N. The nonzero f_table equals the released payload weight and is isolated box-on-table support, not flange/tool contact. Normal twins have no rise/coincidence at the same times. Therefore these are force-history-induced robot sensor/model ringdown mismatches, not hidden input pulses or tool contacts. The forced fz values still genuinely exceed the frozen physical floor, so the rule cannot reject them without forbidden outcome-based floor changes.
